comment: Maps each local skill to the upstream material it adapts. When a tracked upstream file changes, review the mapped local skill and decide manually whether to port anything.

customizations.notes: Adaptive 0-20 question budget instead of open-ended grilling.
Adds reuse-first assessment (do not reinvent the wheel).
Adds certainty labels and root-cause vs symptom separation.
Adds minimal-diff discipline and project memory updates.
Saves into project memory instead of the OS temp directory.
